results.claim: Mounting the panel issues exactly one restore, and never begin/complete on its own
results.evidence: 1 restore after 20 s of faked time

results.claim: A restore answered at 4 s never shows the slow notice and leaves the sign-in button
A restore answered at 6 s shows the slow notice at 5 s, then clears it and the status
A restore answered at 31 s (inside the 35 s bound) succeeds with no timeout alert
A restore that never answers ends in lumi_request_timeout at 35 s with focus on 'check again', and never retries by itself
A host restore answer arriving after the timeout is dropped: no account, no Continue, no callback
'Check saved session again' issues one direct restore (not glued to the hung one); success needs an explicit Continue; a second failure never starts sign-in
A failed re-check shows the error again and still never begins a sign-in
Double-clicking Sign in writes begin once
A begin error shows copy plus code and a 'Try again' that issues one new begin
Open-browser only calls platform.openExternal; double-clicking 'I approved' writes complete once; onSignedIn fires once
A complete answer arriving after the 35 s bound is dropped (no callback); a retry then succeeds exactly once
Cancel during an in-flight complete returns to Sign in, and the superseded complete answer cannot sign the user in
Loading shows a status with inputs disabled; list-projects precedes read-workspace and both carry org/path/environment from props
lumi_page_incomplete shows dedicated copy plus code, no reload button, nothing selectable and no write possible
A retryable load failure offers Reload; one click issues one new list-projects and clears the alert on success
A workspace whose device is unusable shows the device notice and keeps bind disabled
No open projects shows its own placeholder and hint, and bind stays disabled
Double-clicking bind writes bind-workspace once, with confirm:true, the chosen project and the approved display name only
A dropped bind reply triggers a read-only re-read, shows the failure, and never re-issues the bind by itself
If the re-read after a dropped bind also fails, the projection is cleared: bind stays disabled until an explicit reload proves state
